result.summary: Found 3 issues: active Pizza filter does not match displayed restaurants, truncated restaurant name at carousel edge, and inconsistent favorite icon styling.

issues.description: Category filter 'Pizza' is selected but displayed restaurants are non-pizza (Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers, Tokumaru Ramen Bar)
issues.suggestion: Ensure selecting a category filters the restaurant lists to matching cuisines, or clear the active filter state if showing all results

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows restaurant name cut off mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Add end padding to horizontal carousel and use text truncation with ellipsis so names do not clip mid-character

issues.description: Favorite heart icon styling is inconsistent in 'Popular right now' - Tokumaru Ramen Bar heart has no background circle while the pizza card below has a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent favorite button style with translucent dark circular background to all cards for visibility and touch target
